jobs.title: Legal Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Why Equall

Equall is building the legal infrastructure for the private markets — a new system for how corporate legal reality is verified, tracked, and continuously managed.

Our AI-native platform extracts, structures, and reconciles corporate legal information, producing auditable outputs such as a cap table tie-out reports, governance dashboards, and personnel summaries grounded in source documents. Equall executes workflows end to end across both due diligence and day-to-day advisory work, verifying a company’s legal state and surfacing actionable issues in real time.

In practice, this means:

  • Investor-side due diligence delivered in hours, not weeks

  • Company-side client snapshots, continuously updated

  • Legal team review reduced by an order of magnitude

This opportunity comes at a pivotal moment in Equall’s journey. We are working with leading law firms in ECVC and are now entering a period of rapid growth as we scale both our customer base and our product — extending coverage across the venture and emerging companies ecosystem and expanding into private equity and M&A.

Equall brings together leaders across legal, engineering, and AI to deliver transformative value. We listen closely to our customers, build with purpose, and work with both enthusiasm and a steadfast commitment to excellence — driven to reshape how corporate legal work is executed and how legal ground truth is determined.

If you are interested in playing an impactful role in this mission, we would be excited to hear from you.

The Role

We are seeking an exceptional ECVC lawyer to join the team as one of our first Legal Engineers. At Equall, Legal Engineers apply their expertise to review system performance, support law firm customers processing company data rooms through the platform, and design practice-tailored user journeys and workflows.

What You’ll Do

  • Execute agentic due diligence and advisory workflows (e.g., cap table tie-outs and governance review) within the Equall platform

  • Partner with engineers and designers to encode legal processes, develop modeling and product logic, and define how outputs are presented

  • Review system findings and conduct quality assurance testing, advising on both user experience and substantive legal performance

  • Lead the development of additional ECVC or M&A modules, serving as product owner of new user workflows and sub-verticals

  • Engage with law firm customers to understand their needs, translate their processes for the team, and incorporate their feedback into the product

What You’ll Have

  • JD, with at least 2 years of experience practicing ECVC law at a top-tier firm

  • Deep experience running diligence and serving as day-to-day outside counsel to early-stage companies

  • Strong command of venture financing mechanics, company formation, and related documentation

  • Outstanding communication skills and attention to detail, with the ability to work cross-functionally across a multi-disciplinary team

  • Curiosity about how legal work can be systematized and improved, and how AI can be applied to corporate law

jobs.title: Backend Engineer, Foundations
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Why Equall

Equall is building the legal infrastructure for the private markets — a new system for how corporate legal reality is verified, tracked, and continuously managed.

Our AI-native platform extracts, structures, and reconciles corporate legal information, producing auditable outputs such as a cap table tie-out reports, governance dashboards, and personnel summaries grounded in source documents. Equall executes workflows end to end across both due diligence and day-to-day advisory work, verifying a company's legal state and surfacing actionable issues in real time.

In practice, this means:

  • Investor-side due diligence delivered in hours, not weeks

  • Company-side client snapshots, continuously updated

  • Legal team review reduced by an order of magnitude

This opportunity comes at a pivotal moment in Equall's journey. We are working with leading law firms in ECVC and are now entering a period of rapid growth as we scale both our customer base and our product — extending coverage across the venture and emerging companies ecosystem and expanding into private equity and M&A.

Equall brings together leaders across legal, engineering, and AI to deliver transformative value. We listen closely to our customers, build with purpose, and work with both enthusiasm and a steadfast commitment to excellence — driven to reshape how corporate legal work is executed and how legal ground truth is determined.

If you are interested in playing an impactful role in this mission, we would be excited to hear from you.

The Role

We are seeking an exceptional backend engineer to own the graph systems that sit at the heart of Equall's platform. Our knowledge graph is how we represent corporate legal reality — entities, relationships, documents, and claims — and it is what makes agentic legal workflows possible at scale. You will design the APIs, build the data pipelines, and shape the graph infrastructure that turn unstructured legal documents into structured, queryable, auditable legal ground truth. This is a deep backend role — if you take pride in well-designed APIs, reliable pipelines, and production systems that hold up under load, you will feel at home here.

Our Stack

  • Python

  • Prefect for DAG-based orchestration

  • Neo4j for the knowledge graph

  • Postgres and Redis for application data and caching

  • Kubernetes for infrastructure

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and scale the graph infrastructure and data pipelines that power Equall's platform

  • Architect and implement the public APIs that internal services, agents, and customers rely on

  • Build DAG-based processing on Prefect for extracting, transforming, and reconciling legal data from source documents

  • Partner with AI researchers and engineers to integrate agentic systems into production workflows

  • Operate our services on Kubernetes — deployment, observability, and performance

  • Shape engineering standards and architecture for a fast-growing backend team

What You'll Have

  • Strong experience building production backend systems in Python, Go, Rust, or Zig

  • Experience designing and operating data pipelines at scale

  • Deep familiarity with graph databases like Neo4j — modeling, querying, and running them in production

  • Strong opinions on the design of public APIs — ergonomics, versioning, and evolvability

  • Comfort operating services on Kubernetes

  • Excellent judgment on system design tradeoffs and a bias toward shipping

Bonus Points

  • Experience building a graph database (not just using one)

  • Experience designing DAG-based processing or workflow orchestration systems (Prefect, Airflow, Dagster, Temporal, or similar)

  • Experience building agentic systems or integrating LLM-powered workflows into backend infrastructure

  • Experience building control systems or other feedback-driven coordination infrastructure

  • Experience with Kafka or similar event-streaming platforms

jobs.title: Product Counsel
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Product Counsel

New York, NY · On-site · Full-time · Legal & Product

Why Equall

Equall is building the legal infrastructure for the private markets — a new system for how corporate legal reality is verified, tracked, and continuously managed.

Our AI-native platform extracts, structures, and reconciles corporate legal information, producing auditable outputs such as cap table tie-out reports, governance dashboards, and personnel summaries grounded in source documents. Equall executes workflows end to end across both due diligence and day-to-day advisory work, verifying a company’s legal state and surfacing actionable issues in real time.

In practice, this means:

  • Investor-side due diligence delivered in hours, not weeks

  • Company-side client snapshots, continuously updated

  • Legal team review reduced by an order of magnitude

This opportunity comes at a pivotal moment in Equall’s journey. We are working with leading law firms in ECVC and are now entering a period of rapid growh as we scale both our customer base and our product — extending coverage across the venture and emerging companies ecosystem and expanding into private equity and M&A.

Equall brings together leaders across legal, engineering, and AI to deliver transformative value. We listen closely to our customers, build with purpose, and work with both enthusiasm and a steadfast commitment to excellence — driven to reshape how corporate legal work is executed and how legal ground truth is determined.

If you are interested in playing an impactful role in this mission, we would be excited to hear from you.

Job Description

Draft and interpret corporate, venture financing, and M&A documents; manage diligence workflows; advise on corporate governance, equity plans, and cap table structures; translate legal requirements into product processes in collaboration with engineering and design teams. Convert legal requirements and workflows into internal playbooks and product specifications, ensuring that platform features reflect accurate legal logic and compliance requirements. Develop and implement quality-assurance and review protocols for legal content and tools; evaluate legal accuracy across technology-enabled workflows; define metrics and feedback loops to improve reliability and user outcomes.

Minimum requirements

  • Must possess a Juris Doctor (J.D.) in Law and possess an Active New York State Bar License

  • Twenty-four (24) months of experience as a Legal Counsel

Worksite Address: 333 Hudson St. Unit 907 New York, NY 10013

Email resumes to: jorge@equall.com
